name: DREDGE
short_description: A fishing boat captain sells catches around islands that grow stranger after dark.
sources: oracle study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no store fetch, no game files)
summary: A fishing boat captain sells catches around islands that grow stranger after dark.

identity.core_loop: Sail out, fish with timing mini games, pack the hold, sell, upgrade, get home before night.
identity.ui_and_game_feel: Cosy by day, uneasy at night.

hud_coverage.method: Oracle study from public knowledge of the game, in our own words; not yet measured on capture

information_grammar.note: Panic shows as an eye and visual distortion (meta); the hold is a packing grid overlay; night fog is the warning.

identity.lessons_for_abbies_world: A packing-grid inventory is fun on its own; night as the danger signal. Our version stays gentle.
